question: Please convey the complete meaning of this music-teaching source in English, including its conditions, qualifications and alternatives.
answer: The piece begins in 2/4, then changes to 12/8 and 3/4 to heighten the dramatic effect, before returning to 2/4 and reviving the lively opening mood. The use of 2/4 rather than 4/4 can be understood as a way to make the contrast between strong and weak beats clearer. Each 2/4 measure has a strong–weak pattern, whereas 4/4 generally has a strong–weak–moderately strong–weak pattern. Thus, when contrasting figures appear in two successive measures, the first beat of each 2/4 measure receives emphasis and the character of both figures comes through clearly. This highlights the contrast between the figures and brings out the lively mood more effectively than placing both figures within a single 4/4 measure.
